title: Trade centres of coastal Andhra: more goods, ports, later history

boxes.title: More exports
items: **Textiles**: ==dominant pre-colonial industry==, second only to diamonds in the Qutb Shahi economy
Also: carpets, iron, steel, swords, lacquer toys, leather, footwear, sesame, castor, sugar, wax
Textile ports to England, France, Holland: **Kalingapatnam**, Srikakulam, Vizag, Bhimunipatnam, **Corangi**, Kakinada

boxes.title: Company-era trade
items: Imports: metals, minerals, porcelain, liquor, drugs, medicines
Coastal boats: salt + groceries to **Yanam, Bengal, Rangoon, Chittagong** → back ==rice and grains==
Weavers for the Dutch paid in **Madras pagodas**
Debate: ==high Company duties ruined Andhra trade==
